concerns.text: FR-002 and FR-009 require retaining records with missing 'contact_load'/'sliding_speed' with a 'raw' flag, but T013d (flag_raw_records) is marked as '[~]' (incomplete/rejected) and T012 (handle_missing_values) is marked as '[ ]' (unverified). There is no active, verified task that successfully implements the logic to set 'normalization_method='raw'' and separate these records, blocking FR-013 (training only on normalized) and FR-011 (sensitivity analysis).

FR-001 requires ingestion from 'at least 3 distinct sources'. T010 (fetch_sources) is marked '[ ]' (unverified) and T009b (mock data) is marked '[ ]' (unverified). The Analyze report confirms 'aggregated_raw.csv' is missing. Without a verified task to generate this artifact, FR-001 and SC-007 (schema mismatch check) cannot be satisfied.

FR-006 specifies a fallback to 'Linear Regression only' if 'normalized subset size per class is < 30'. T020 and T021 describe fallbacks to 'K-Fold' or 'Linear Regression' generally but lack the specific '< 30 records-per-class' threshold check logic. No task explicitly implements this specific conditional branch required by the spec.

FR-006 requires updating the 'study_scope' to 'within_material_prediction' if LOMO fallback is triggered. T021a (update_scope_report) is scheduled to run AFTER T033 (generate_final_report). This ordering means the final report generated in T033 will lack the correct scope status, and T021a's update is not defined to trigger a re-generation of the report, leaving the final artifact non-compliant with FR-006.

FR-011 requires a sensitivity analysis comparing 'normalized-only' vs 'full' subsets. T023 suggests running 'separate models or a unified model with the flag as a feature'. The spec FR-013 explicitly forbids mixing 'raw' records into the primary training set. T023 does not explicitly mandate training two separate models to ensure a fair comparison, risking a methodological error where the 'raw' data is inadvertently used in the primary model.

T016c (write_pre_check) is scheduled to run after T016b (compare_thresholds). T016b is defined to 'halt (exit code 1)' if normalized_count < 100. If T016b halts, T016c will never execute, yet T016c is responsible for writing the 'reports/pre_check.json' artifact. The task list lacks a mechanism to write this artifact even in a failure state, which may be needed for audit logs.
